FN-6PSA33-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 337
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Kyle South
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/24/2023
House Bill 337 as introduced would (1) allow the State Comptroller to make payments to
vendors for which they are entitled from a prior fiscal year; and (2) codify the current practice of
allowing the Department of Finance, or its divisions, to charge fees for services provided.
According to the Department, it collected approximately $39 million in various fees during
Fiscal Year 2022..

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 337
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Kyle South
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/26/2023
House Bill 337 as reported by the Ways and Means General Fund Committee would (1) allow
the State Comptroller to make payments to vendors for which they are entitled from a prior
fiscal year from funds of the affected agency; and (2) codify the current practice of allowing the
Department of Finance, or its divisions, to charge fees for services provided.
According to the Department, it collected approximately $39 million in various fees during
Fiscal Year 2022..
